rules.description: Ensure poverty percentage values are non-negative (>= 0.0%).
Ensure poverty percentage values do not exceed 100.0%.
Verify Persistent Poverty County and territory coverage is between 400 and 450 places.
Verify total observation count across benchmark years is between 1,200 and 1,350.
Ensure MaxDate is uniform across all StatVars in the import.
Verify MinDate is 1990 and MaxDate is between 2020 and 2026.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, MinDate, MaxDate FROM stats
params.condition: TRY_CAST(MinDate AS INT) = 1990 AND TRY_CAST(MaxDate AS INT) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2026

rules.description: Ensure zero unresolved entity or schema references.
Ensure zero MCF/TMCF lint errors in generated output.
Allow at most 0.1% deleted records across refreshes.
